summary.text: Asura Transformation is Ouyang Bi Sang's killer move. He grows into a dark-green giant with six arms and a third vertical eye.

claims.text: Hei tribe talk after Bian Si Xuan, called Shadow Sword Expert, retreats treats asura transformation as a killer move apart from asura zombie Gu. Speakers there say that killer move killed a rank five expert, and that in this challenge he has used only asura zombie Gu, not his full strength.

Hei tribe then sends three rank four experts to stop him from killing Pan Ping. Under that surround he tells Mo Shi Kuang not to interfere and activates the killer move. His aura rises, his body grows over ten feet, his muscles inflate into rock-like bulges, two new pairs of arms grow under his existing pair, his leather boots tear, and his fangs turn dark brown. He roars, swats one expert away, then uses all six hands together, punching, swatting, grabbing, and holding, until one of the remaining two is smashed into blood paste and the other is crushed in his grip.

Gao Yang pins him with cloud rope Gu. He answers first with asura zombie Gu, breaks the rope, and takes to the air. Treacherous cloud wave Gu then covers him and wrecks his sense of direction. He shouts Asura transformation. Six thick arms that look as if they were cast in bronze stretch through the grey cloud, his body inflates, his battle strength rises several times, and he shakes the cloud apart, then joins Mo Shi Kuang against Gao Yang and Zhu Zai.

Fang Yuan questions whether the three brothers’ combination joins asura transformation, qi path attack, and light path effects. After that fusion splits, Ouyang Bi Sang still has enough primeval essence to activate asura transformation again while hunting Fang Yuan under the Chang Shan Yin name.
